description: This file defines a Java interface 'SearchProperty' used within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.thingsearch' package. It specifies methods for creating various search filters based on property attributes such as existence, equality, comparison, pattern matching, and membership, for use in search queries related to 'Things'. It also provides a method to retrieve the property path as a 'JsonPointer'.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Returns a new filter to check if the property exists.

methods.name: eq
methods.description: Creates a filter checking if the property value is equal to the provided value (overloaded for boolean, int, long, double, String).

methods.name: ne
methods.description: Creates a filter checking if the property value is not equal to the provided value (overloaded for boolean, int, long, double, String).

methods.name: ge
methods.description: Creates a filter checking if the property value is greater than or equal to the provided value (overloaded for boolean, int, long, double, String).

methods.name: gt
methods.description: Creates a filter checking if the property value is greater than the provided value (overloaded for boolean, int, long, double, String).

methods.name: le
methods.description: Creates a filter checking if the property value is less than or equal to the provided value (overloaded for boolean, int, long, double, String).

methods.name: lt
methods.description: Creates a filter checking if the property value is less than the provided value (overloaded for boolean, int, long, double, String).

methods.name: like
methods.description: Creates a filter to check if the property value matches a pattern.

methods.name: in
methods.description: Creates a filter to check if the property value is in a set of values, supporting multiple overloads for different types and collections.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path of this property.
